d4_governance_discoveries.name: 覆盖连续性预检 (coverage continuity precheck)
d4_governance_discoveries.symptom: 条件域收窄产生无规则覆盖的连续区间 -> ABDL 落入无命名默认分支, 行为随机化
d4_governance_discoveries.evidence: sensor(opponent_angle) < -10 -> < -15 后 (-15,-10)∪(10,15) 无匹配; 裸 'abdl' 键 92 次; avg_steps +59%
d4_governance_discoveries.rule: 规则拓扑候选 apply 前必须执行覆盖连续性预检; 条件域收窄/迁移类变更 需验证邻居规则在收窄区间有覆盖 (或候选同时补足覆盖), 否则标 COVERAGE_GAP 拦截
d4_governance_discoveries.trigger: diff 含 sensor(<dim>) < X -> < Y (Y<X) 或 > X -> > Y (Y>X) 或 BETWEEN 收窄

d4_governance_discoveries.name: 慢局归因修正 (FLANK 高频重复, 非 stuck 死锁)
d4_governance_discoveries.source: FP-NEG-006 / Sprint 31 topo_E/topo_F 双 no-op 证伪
d4_governance_discoveries.symptom: 分支高频触发被误判为死循环/stuck, 导致错误的退出机制设计
d4_governance_discoveries.evidence: ep7 FLANK-RIGHT 45 + CAUTIOUS-EDGE 13; topo_F stuck_counter<3 逐位 no-op (stuck 恒<3); topo_E 0.55->0.60 空采样
d4_governance_discoveries.rule: FLANK 类分支高频重复触发时, 先用 branch_hist 逐局验证触发时 stuck_counter 是否真达到阈值; 若恒<3 则干预点应为触发次数上限 (per-episode cap), 而非 stuck 传感器门控
d4_governance_discoveries.trigger: 慢局 (>30 步) 由单一分支 >40 次触发主导

d4_governance_discoveries.name: 冗余分支识别 (CAUTIOUS-EDGE 可无损替代)
d4_governance_discoveries.source: Sprint 31 topo_A 回放 (INCONCLUSIVE -> SUSPICIOUS, M2 四通道捕获)
d4_governance_discoveries.symptom: 分支触发域被邻居规则覆盖时, 分支本身近似冗余
d4_governance_discoveries.evidence: CLOSE-PUSH edge 0.65->0.80 对齐后 CAUTIOUS-EDGE 13->0 消失, 步数仅 -1
d4_governance_discoveries.rule: 若某分支的触发域被邻居规则完全包含, 且移除后步数变化 <=1, 标记为冗余候选 (S32 候选 G); 移除评估须在覆盖预检 (D4-1) 稳定后进行
d4_governance_discoveries.trigger: 覆盖投影显示分支触发域 ⊆ 邻居触发域
